name: koreanpulse
description: English-first Korean equity intelligence as an MCP server. Query Korean DART (전자공시) filings, KOSPI/KOSDAQ disclosures, foreign-holder 5%-rule flows (BlackRock / Vanguard / Norges / GIC / Temasek + more) and Korean activist filings (KCGI / Align / ValueAct / Elliott), with on-demand English translation and named-entity classification. Free public daily snapshot at koreanpulse.dev/today. Cloud tiers (Solo $29 / Analyst $79 / Desk $249 per month) add the watchlist-to-alert workflow shipping Q3 2026 — early-supporter pricing locks in, no auto-charge until it ships. OSS self-host (AGPL) available.

tools.name: track_korean_filings
tools.description: Fetch recent DART filings for Korean listed companies with optional EN translation/summary.

tools.name: lookup_corp_code
tools.description: Resolve a Korean company name (or partial name) to its DART corp_code.

tools.name: resolve_stock_code
tools.description: Resolve a 6-digit KRX stock code to its DART corp entry.

tools.name: search_korean_industry_news
tools.description: Search recent Korean industry news (etnews / 한국경제) classified into 16 industries.

tools.name: monitor_activist_investors
tools.description: Watch DART type-D shareholding disclosures with Korean activist auto-tagging (KCGI, Align, Truston, Anda, Cha, Life, Platform, VIP, plus international ValueAct / Elliott).

tools.name: monitor_foreign_holders
tools.description: Watch DART type-D 5%-rule disclosures by foreign passive holders (BlackRock, Vanguard, State Street, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, Wellington, Norges, GIC, Temasek, Goldman, JPM, Morgan Stanley, Citadel, Millennium, Bridgewater + 5 more). Leading indicator of foreign capital flow into Korean tickers.

tools.name: koreanpulse_about
tools.description: Server metadata — version, available tools, corp index size.

env.name: DART_API_KEY
env.description: Korea FSS DART OpenAPI key. Free at https://opendart.fss.or.kr/. 40,000 calls/day per key.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI key for server-side translation/summary (default provider, gpt-5-mini).

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic key, alternative provider when KOREANPULSE_TRANSLATE_PROVIDER=anthropic.

env.name: KOREANPULSE_CACHE_MODE
env.description: 'local' (OSS self-host, default — uses your own OPENAI_API_KEY) or 'hosted' (Cloud Solo/Analyst/Desk — calls koreanpulse-cache Worker for global cache + license-gated translation).

env.name: KOREANPULSE_LICENSE_KEY
env.description: License key for the hosted classifier tools, required when KOREANPULSE_CACHE_MODE=hosted.

oss_self_host.note: AGPL source. Run the MCP locally with your own DART_API_KEY + OPENAI_API_KEY. Community support only — no alerts, no hosted archive, no shared translation cache, no account sync. Separate lane from the Cloud tiers; not a pricing tier. (Cloud customers also install the MCP locally today; a true HTTP-transport remote MCP is on the Q3 2026 roadmap.)
